summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) on September 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the initiation of Phase IIa of its Phase I/IIa clinical trial for CMND-100, a psychedelic-derived therapeutic candidate for alcohol use disorder (AUD). Six patients have been enrolled across two Israeli medical centers, with three at Tel Aviv Sourasky and three at Hadassah. The trial is a four-part study evaluating safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy. The filing is a routine operational milestone update, containing no financial terms, merger, or special-situation elements. It merely reports clinical progress and incorporates the press release into registration statements, so no corporate action or strategic event is involved.
